content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to this and attempted to connect to AWS by creating a Thing. After step 3, I received a message: 'Cannot connect to AWS IoT. Make sure your computer is connected to the internet, and the access key is valid.' I am certain my access key and password are correct, so I suspect an internet access issue. In the access control settings, it says: 'Cloud Access: secured.' If anyone has a solution for this, I'd appreciate your help. Thank you, [user_name]

Hi [user_name], You could reach out to [company_name] Support Team for individual assistance at no cost. Please check your personal area under 'My Forum' where you can find our support offer. Regards, [product_name] Support
Hello, Have you set your device clock? Regards, [user_name]
I'm facing the same issue even after synchronizing the device clock.

analysis.insight_summary: Several users are unable to connect their devices to AWS IoT, even though they have confirmed their credentials and synchronized their device clocks. The error points toward problems with either internet connectivity or access control, but users believe their network setup is correct. The discussion indicates uncertainty about which settings are truly preventing successful connection.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable connectivity between their devices and AWS IoT when they have supplied correct credentials and internet access. They also seek clear troubleshooting guidance from the product interface or documentation.
